items.summary: You look familiar.
items.body: Longtime FromSoftware dataminer Zullie the Witch has come out with a new video showing off the close-up details of Elden Ring's two new NPC invaders. Knight Leontiel and Noble Broken Mask were both added to the game as part of Elden Ring's Tarnished Edition DLC. Knight Leontiel is a straight "hey, I know them" reference to Lucatiel of Mirrah from Dark Souls 2, boasting an HD remaster of her signature conquistador fit and nimble greatsword. Take off the mask, though, and Leontiel practically is Lucatiel, even down to a burn mark over her left eye that corresponds to the hollowing rot Lucatiel suffered in Dark Souls 2. Noble Broken Mask, meanwhile, may obliquely give us a better idea of what his base game counterpart and spiritual rival, Goldmask, is supposed to look like. Goldmask's model has a face, but it seems like a generic placeholder element. Broken Mask has an austere, pinched face with striking pale gold eyes, and Zullie points out that he bears a more than passing resemblance to the typically obscured faces of Elden Ring's perfumer enemies. items.title: After the debacle of Cyberpunk 2077, CD Projekt says The Witcher 4 is already running on PC and consoles, promises 'it's going to run' on all target platforms
items.summary: Sure, it's a low bar, but after the Cyberpunk 2077 fiasco you can understand why CD Projekt Red would want to make the point.
items.body: Cyberpunk 2077 now is one of the best RPGs money can buy. But Cyberpunk 2077 then , which is to say when it was new, was not. It was pretty okay on PC , aside from a horde of bugs, but it was such a performance catastrophe on the PlayStation 4 that Sony literally booted it off the PlayStation Store . Even when it was allowed back in the building six months later, Sony slapped a notice on it warning people that it was still potentially dodgy . Speaking to Game Developer , CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michał Nowakowski said that failure arose from the studio's ambitions for the game, which led it to develop on PC first. "We want[ed] to push the boundaries of what is doable in terms of cinematic feeling and whatnot [in Cyberpunk 2077], and PC was just the best suited rig for that," Nowakowski said. "There was this, as it turned out, false belief that toning it down to whatever was the current gen is not going to be that much of a challenge." items.title: Blizzard doing 'a thorough scrub' of illegitimate World of Warcraft Mythic-Plus dungeon rankings, with more changes to come
items.summary: Paid boosting was particularly controversial in this instance, because it pushed legitimate records out of the top-1% reward category.
items.body: Blizzard is scrubbing through its new World of Warcraft Mythic Plus Dungeon top-1% rankings for people who paid for carries, World of Warcraft game director Ion Hazzikostas says. The timed dungeon mode offered its first-ever rewards at that level this past season in the Midnight expansion, which ended August 11. Unlike similar high-end rewards in PvP combat, this ranking level in Mythic Plus dungeons was a flat percentage of players, rather than a set score they had to achieve. Some players paid for the privilege, and the glowy red-and-black bird mount that came with the title. These boosts were particularly controversial, as the percentage cutoff meant that every successful carry removed a player that legitimately earned the score. "The team is doing a thorough scrub of this for Season 1 and will share more with the community soon about how we approached that review, as well as the final results," Hazzikostas said. items.body: الاتحاد يُكثف تحركاته بحثا عن تدعيمات جديدة في الخط الأمامي يُكثّف نادي الاتحاد تحركاته في سوق الانتقالات الصيفية الجارية، بحثًا عن تدعيمات جديدة في الخط الأمامي، مع اقتراب إغلاق باب القيد. وكشفت صحيفة " الشرق الأوسط " أن إدارة الاتحاد تدرس دعم مركز الجناح بأحد نجوم أستون فيلا الإنجليزي، في ظل الحاجة إلى إضافة لاعب يملك السرعة والخبرة في الملاعب الأوروبية. وأكدت أن العميد وضع عينيه على الجامايكي ليون بايلي "29 عامًا" جناح أستون فيلا، الذي سبق له خوض تجربة بارزة مع باير ليفركوزن الألماني، قبل أن ينتقل إلى الفيلانز، كما خاض فترة قصيرة بقميص روما الإيطالي. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشترِ تذكرتك الآنَ! وشارك الجناح الجامايكي مع أستون فيلا في 163 مباراة في مختلف البطولات، أحرز خلالها 23 هدفًا، وأسهم بـ25 تمريرة حاسمة. ولا يقتصر بحث الاتحاد على بايلي؛ إذ كان اسم الكولومبي ياسر أسبريلا، جناح جيرونا الإسباني، قد برز سابقًا ضمن قائمة المرشحين لتقوية الخيارات الهجومية للفريق قبل إسدال الستار على فترة الانتقالات الصيفية، وفقا للمصدر نفسه. اقرأ أيضا: 15 مليون يورو لا تكفي؟.. بنفيكا يغلق بابه في وجه الاتحاد اقرأ أيضا: رجل المستحيل.. رئيس الأرجنتين يودع ميسي

items.title: Empulse and Splitgate: Arena Reloaded are officially over as 1047 Games says it's probably done making arena shooters
items.summary: The studio will remain operational, but its next game "may look very different" from what it's done before.
items.body: Just two months after the release of the PvP arena shooter Empulse , 1047 Games is halting work on the game and its predecessor, Splitgate: Arena Reloaded , saying that neither is making enough money to support their operating costs. The studio itself will remain but its "focus is changing," and its next game "may look very different from what people expect." The original Splitgate: Arena Warfare was something of a phenom when it debuted in 2019, which was a blessing and a curse: The crossplay beta test was a mess because the game was so popular, and its final release was delayed so 1047 could revamp its server infrastructure . The money flowed in and 1047 co-founder and CEO Ian Proulx mused about being the next Riot Games , but the wheels came off with Splitgate 2 ; its follow-up, Empulse, showed early promise but failed to cause much of a stir, and just a month after that game's release, the company laid off a number of employees . And now work on both games has ended entirely. "The reality is that neither game is generating enough revenue to support the ongoing cost of dedicated servers," 1047 said in a Steam update . items.title: Some of WoW's hardest dungeons and raids have gotten just a bit easier—that's on purpose, developers say
items.summary: "People are a little bit more willing now to say, 'Well I'd like to try out tanking. I'd like to try out healing.'"
items.body: World of Warcraft's developers are making some subtle shifts in dungeons and raids to help players with its more-difficult content, in the hopes that a variety of knock-on effects result, including increased participation in the game overall and a better balance of tanks, healers and damage dealers. In the case of WoW's timed-dungeon Mythic Plus mode, it was a matter of making it just a bit easier to get to the mythic-level rewards of the weekly vault, says Paul Kubit, associate game director in charge of the Midnight expansion. The team tested it out in the first season of Mythic Plus, which just wrapped up. Reducing Mythic Plus difficulty to entice support players Players are often less-willing to queue for dungeons as tanks or healers because the level of responsibility is much higher—taking the big hits, keeping the group alive, directing where the party should go—and other players can be swift to judge when things go wrong. Hopefully the reduced difficulty for the weekly "vault filler" keys, where players are typically looking to complete the minimum level of Mythic Plus dungeons that will get them the maximum level of gear available, helps with those stressors, Kubit says. There are things I've done that can't be forgiven, mostly relating to that time I drove a Chinese anti-air missile truck into Beverly Hills, and someone should make me face consequences for that. Alas, in GTA 5 , no one will unless I make them. So I made them. I have installed Ambient Hit Squads , a mod inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2 that will dispatch armed men to eliminate you every so often as you're out exploring the game's world. This functions more or less as it should in my nightmare-frankenstein version of GTA, already lumbering under so many mods.
